chunks: We know well with what (intent) they hear you, for when they confer privately the wicked say: "You follow but a man deluded."
ai.seo_question: What did the hypocrites say about the Prophet Muhammad in their private gatherings?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the divine omniscience that penetrates the private whispers (najwa) of the hypocrites, validating the Prophet's status against their claim of him being 'meshour' (enchanted or bewitched). It serves as a refutation of those who attributed his miraculous teachings to external sorcery rather than divine revelation, a theme central to the struggle between true faith and superficial skepticism.
